WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_tallies
)
SELECT archstat, tally, share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares);
